import math
import re

def analyze_video(scope_title):
    scope_node = node_by_title(doc, scope_title)
    if scope_node is None: return
    scope_children = children(doc, scope_node)
    
    motion_node = None
    events_node = None
    objects_node = None
    for child in scope_children:
        t = child.get("title", "")
        if t.endswith(": Motion log"): motion_node = child
        elif t.endswith(": Events"): events_node = child
        elif t.endswith(": Objects"): objects_node = child
        
    if not motion_node or not events_node: return
    
    motion = {}
    for row in motion_node["table"]["rows"]:
        frame = int(row[0])
        obj_m = re.match(r'(\d+)\s', row[1])
        if obj_m:
            obj_id = obj_m.group(1)
            motion[(obj_id, frame)] = {
                "x": float(row[2]), "y": float(row[3]),
                "vx": float(row[4]), "vy": float(row[5]),
                "speed": float(row[6])
            }
            
    collisions = []
    for line in events_node.get("lines", []):
        cm = re.match(r'Frame (\d+): Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*and\s*Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*collide', line)
        if cm:
            collisions.append({"frame": int(cm.group(1)), "obj1": cm.group(2), "obj2": cm.group(3)})
            
    print(f"\n=== {scope_title} ===")
    for col in collisions:
        f = col["frame"]
        o1, o2 = col["obj1"], col["obj2"]
        if (o1, f) in motion and (o2, f) in motion:
            m1, m2 = motion[(o1, f)], motion[(o2, f)]
            dx = m1["x"] - m2["x"]
            dy = m1["y"] - m2["y"]
            dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
            print(f"Collision at frame {f}: {o1} and {o2}, dist={dist:.3f}, v1={m1['speed']:.2f}, v2={m2['speed']:.2f}")

import math
import re

def analyze_collision(scope_title):
    scope_node = node_by_title(doc, scope_title)
    if not scope_node: return
    scope_children = children(doc, scope_node)
    
    motion_node = events_node = None
    for c in scope_children:
        t = c.get("title", "")
        if t.endswith(": Motion log"): motion_node = c
        elif t.endswith(": Events"): events_node = c
    if not motion_node or not events_node: return
    
    motion = {}
    for row in motion_node["table"]["rows"]:
        f = int(row[0])
        om = re.match(r'(\d+)\s', row[1])
        if om:
            oid = om.group(1)
            motion[(oid, f)] = {"x": float(row[2]), "y": float(row[3]), "vx": float(row[4]), "vy": float(row[5])}
            
    collisions = []
    for line in events_node.get("lines", []):
        cm = re.match(r'Frame (\d+): Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*and\s*Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*collide', line)
        if cm:
            collisions.append((int(cm.group(1)), cm.group(2), cm.group(3)))
            
    for f, o1, o2 in collisions:
        # Get velocities just before collision (previous frame for each)
        frames1 = sorted([ff for ff in range(f-1, -1, -1) if (o1, ff) in motion])
        frames2 = sorted([ff for ff in range(f-1, -1, -1) if (o2, ff) in motion])
        if not frames1 or not frames2: continue
        p1 = motion[(o1, frames1[0])]
        p2 = motion[(o2, frames2[0])]
        
        # Velocities at collision frame
        a1 = motion.get((o1, f))
        a2 = motion.get((o2, f))
        if not a1 or not a2: continue
        
        # Relative velocity before
        rvx = p1["vx"] - p2["vx"]
        rvy = p1["vy"] - p2["vy"]
        
        # Relative velocity after
        rvx_a = a1["vx"] - a2["vx"]
        rvy_a = a1["vy"] - a2["vy"]
        
        # Normal direction (approximate from positions)
        nx = p1["x"] - p2["x"]
        ny = p1["y"] - p2["y"]
        nd = math.hypot(nx, ny)
        if nd < 1e-5: continue
        nx, ny = nx/nd, ny/nd
        
        # Relative velocity along normal
        rvn = rvx*nx + rvy*ny
        rvn_a = rvx_a*nx + rvy_a*ny
        
        e_est = -rvn_a / rvn if abs(rvn) > 1e-3 else None
        
        print(f"{scope_title} Frame {f}: {o1}x{o2} | rvn={rvn:.3f}, rvn_a={rvn_a:.3f}, e_est={e_est:.3f} | v1={math.hypot(p1['vx'],p1['vy']):.2f}->{math.hypot(a1['vx'],a1['vy']):.2f} v2={math.hypot(p2['vx'],p2['vy']):.2f}->{math.hypot(a2['vx'],a2['vy']):.2f}")

        for line_idx, line in enumerate(node.get("lines", [])):
            fm = re.match(r'Frame (\d+): (.+)', line)
            if fm:
                rest = fm.group(2)
                cm = re.match(r'Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*and\s*Object (\d+)\s*\(.*?\)\s*collide', rest)
                if cm:
                    scopes_with_collisions.add(scope_title)

                        "scope": scope_title,
                        "frame": int(fm.group(1)),
                        "obj1": cm.group(1),
                        "obj2": cm.group(2)
                    })

    for child in children_nodes:
        if child.get("title", "").endswith(": Motion log"):
